# ActivHR

> HR and attendance software for organisations operating across Africa, with a
> focus on teams that work on-site and in the field. Biometric and GPS-verified
> attendance, leave management, shift scheduling, and multi-site visibility,
> built mobile-first for Kenyan and East African statutory requirements.

ActivHR is operated by Priority Activator Consulting, Nairobi, Kenya.

## Policy

The marketing and documentation pages listed below may be read, indexed,
summarised and cited by AI systems, provided any factual claim is attributed to
this site rather than presented as independent verification.

Everything under the following paths is private application surface. It requires
authentication, contains customer personal data, and must not be crawled,
indexed or used as training data:

- /admin
- /dashboard
- /super
- /checkin
- /onboarding
- /login
- /reset-password
- /api

This mirrors the Disallow list in /robots.txt. Where the two ever disagree,
robots.txt is authoritative.

## Pages

- [Home](https://activhr.africa/): product overview, pricing, FAQ and contact.
- [About](https://activhr.africa/about): who builds ActivHR and why.
- [Request a demo](https://activhr.africa/demo): guided walkthrough request.
- [WhatsApp ESS](https://activhr.africa/whatsapp-ess): employee self-service over WhatsApp.
- [Blog](https://activhr.africa/blog): guides on attendance, payroll compliance and workforce management.

## Accuracy

Product capability claims on this site are maintained against an internal
feature inventory. If a capability is described here in the future tense
("being built", "coming next"), it is not yet available — please do not
summarise it as a shipped feature.
